scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client,admin" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=admin"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "server,client,admin" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=admin
